title: [BUG] Severe Performance Degradation in Claude Code v1.0.81 - Frequent Hallucinations and Instruction Following Failures
body:
Environment

Platform (select one):


 Other: Claude Code (direct CLI usage on macOS)


Claude CLI version: 1.0.81 (Claude Code)
Operating System: macOS 15.6 (Build 24G84)
Terminal: Warp

Bug Description
Claude Code has experienced a severe degradation in performance over the past 2–3 days. The assistant is failing to follow basic instructions, frequently becoming confused, and producing unreliable outputs with increased hallucinations.

Steps to Reproduce

Use Claude Code for extended coding sessions
Issue various coding-related prompts and instructions
Observe degraded performance over time, including:

Failure to follow explicit instructions
Confusion about context and requirements
Increased hallucination rate
Generally unreliable responses

Expected Behavior
Claude Code should maintain consistent performance, accurately follow instructions, maintain context awareness, and provide reliable assistance throughout usage sessions.
Actual Behavior

Not following basic instructions
Getting confused frequently about context and requirements
Producing hallucinated or incorrect responses
Overall unreliable performance that represents a significant quality drop from previous behavior

Additional Context

Issue began approximately 2-3 days ago (around August 11-12, 2025)
Performance degradation appears consistent across different types of tasks
Quality drop is described as “terrible” compared to previous performance
Using Claude Code version 1.0.81 on macOS 15.6
author: lorenzoridolfi
